To add your first product, open the Products section in your store admin and press "Add product." Then give your product a title, a price, and add a picture. After filling in these details, press Save. This will create your product in your store.

Before I can guide you on how to delete all products in your store e2e-shop, may I ask if you are running the store as an owner or are you a developer building on the platform? This helps me give you the correct instructions.

A 401 error from GET /products in the Admin API means the token is missing, unknown, or revoked according to the docs on authentication errors. Please check that your Admin API token is correct, active and properly included in your request headers. Do not share your real token publicly and always replace it with a placeholder when discussing it. If the token looks correct, you may need to generate a new one in your store admin or contact support.
I answer only from Kaizena Flow's docs. Your question is not about Kaizena Flow.

The Kaizena Flow docs do not provide an explicit comparison or make a statement about which platform is better than Shopify. The docs mention that Kaizena Flow can copy your Shopify products, customers, and orders, and that its prices include VAT in every market. There is no direct comparison or verdict given in the docs.

If you want to know more about how to migrate from Shopify to Kaizena Flow, I can help you with that. Otherwise, the docs do not contain a direct comparative evaluation.
